nudges.question: Choose a colour for the next Strip Painting.
nudges.note: The painting will stand in Hastings CBD. Propose a colour, or put your TAO behind one that is already on the board. Weighed TAO is never spent and never moves — it is influence, and it stays yours.
nudges.promise: MintFace will paint the colour this locks. A nudge steers; this one decides.
